title: Council front-door tool input
description: Least-privilege input for one enquiry. The tool quotes a synthetic catalogue page or returns a handover. It does not decide eligibility, write a case, send a message, take a payment, or book an appointment. Those fields are not accepted.

enquiry_id.description: Synthetic id. A live identifier is not an input this schema accepts.

synthetic.description: Must be true for this starter. The core refuses anything else and does not echo the text.

as_of.description: The day the adviser is reading the enquiry, YYYY-MM-DD.
